Kids basketball in Copenhagen, ages 5 to 12

Talata Mini (5 to 9) and Talata Junior (10 to 12) train back to back on Østerbro, same gym, same coaches. The kids are moving the whole hour. If they are not having fun they will not come back, and we know it.

Talata Mini

For 5 to 9 year olds. Most of them have never played before. Come once a week or twice, whatever suits your family.

Nobody stands in a line watching one kid shoot. They dribble, pass, take turns and play small games, at the level a 7 year old can manage. The group is small, so the coaches know every kid by name.

What matters most at this age is that your kid wants to come back next week.

Training schedule

We train Tuesday and Thursday at Strandvejsskolen and Saturday morning at Kulturhuset Indre By. Come once a week or more, whichever works for you. Each session is one hour and we run through the whole season.

Junior basketball for ages 10 to 12

Junior is the next step once the basics are there. More fundamentals, more games, and it leads into Academy when they are ready.

Every week
Tue + Thu 16:30 to 18:00 at Strandvejsskolen, Sat 11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By
Same gym, right after Mini. One pickup if you have kids in both. 1.800 kr / half-season.
Book a trial

Academy U12 Camp

If your kid has never touched a basketball before, a camp is an easier way in than a regular session. Four days with other kids at the same level and nobody watching to see how good they are.

Academy U12 Camp is for ages 5 to 11 and runs Mon 12 to Thu 15 October over the autumn break, 09:30 to 14:30 Monday to Wednesday at Hafnia-Hallen. Tuesday mixes court time with a session upstairs in the middle of the day, and Thursday is game day with every age group, 12:30 to 14:30. Hot lunch included Monday to Wednesday, plus snacks and fruit. 1.195 kr. 35 places.

A lot of kids who come to a camp end up in the weekly sessions afterwards. The coaches already know them by then, so turning up on a Tuesday is not the same leap.

After Mini

At 10, kids move from Mini into Talata Junior. Same gym, straight after Mini.

At 13 they move up to Talata Academy, where it turns into competitive basketball with league games and video review. Kids who came up through Mini and Junior already know the coaches, so the jump is not a shock.

When your child is ready to move up, we get in touch and set them up on the next team.
